svg.title: Expand Q = P PT, use the exchange symmetries of the two tensor pairs, and commute the scalar multipliers Pj; this gives B = P 2 i A + R1 and C = P 2 i B + R2 exactly. The compensated Q has no contact jet of total order below three by (RT0b). On widths ≤λa this costs 3a with arbitrarily small exponent slack. Multiplication by one frequency costs a and by three costs 3a; hence (RT15) costs 4a and 6a, respectively. This proves the powers asserted after (RT8). Vanishing on profiles with the required moments follows directly by evaluating the finite contact polynomial on those moments. The exterior-flux powers can also be made explicit.
